title: Garware Hi-Tech Films Ltd (NSE: GRWRHITECH) — Institutional Research Dossier
primer: Garware Hi-Tech Films (NSE: GRWRHITECH) has shifted from a low-margin packaging maker into a specialty film leader. Value-added Paint Protection Films and Solar Control Films now drive 86%–87% of sales [11, 21]. The firm holds zero long-term debt, ₹933 Cr in cash, and 18.1% ROCE while posting 28.7% H1 FY27 EBITDA margins [1, 6, 8, 11]. It earns COMPOUNDER_PASS with a watch on US tariffs (~51% of sales), 149-day inventory, and an 8% dividend payout [1, 23].
